identified_defects.description: max_consistency_delta_u was computed and printed after the final mechanical solve but never tested against the declared 1e-9 mm tolerance or included in physical_pass predicate.
identified_defects.remediation: In driver_package171_r4_c6_coupled_pdas.py, consistency_u_pass = (max_consistency_delta_u <= 1e-9 mm) is strictly enforced in the physical_pass predicate.

identified_defects.description: Final history was recomputed from the final displacement without checking its change against the 1e-4 MPa coupled-history tolerance before checkpoint serialization.
identified_defects.remediation: In driver_package171_r4_c6_coupled_pdas.py, max_consistency_delta_h = max(abs(history_final[k] - history_staggered[k])) is computed and consistency_h_pass = (max_consistency_delta_h <= 1e-4 MPa) is strictly enforced in physical_pass.

identified_defects.description: The R3 regression test suite checked consistency delta_u with mock illustrative arrays instead of exercising the driver's actual checkpoint decision and serialization path.
identified_defects.remediation: Created test_package171_r4_c6_coupled_driver_gates.py with 4 unit tests exercising the actual driver method (finalize_coupled_acceptance) for excessive displacement correction, excessive history correction, failed KKT stationarity, and a compliant passing state.

regression_tests.test_package171_r4_c6_coupled_driver_gat: PASS (4/4 tests: excessive delta_u, excessive delta_H, failed KKT, compliant pass)
regression_tests.test_package171_r4_c6_coupled_driver_rea: PASS (7/7 tests: C6 topology, transferred state integrity, frozen UEL preservation, driver parameters, manifest hashes, runtime closure, PBS structure)
